resources.string: On the next screen, find Meret and turn on autostart or allow it to run in the background. Without this, the phone may stop recording your track when the screen is off.
Open the recent apps screen, then lock the Meret card: pull it down or long-press it and tap the lock icon.
Open the Phone Master app, go to \"App management\" then \"Auto-start\", and turn Meret on.
Open Settings, then \"Apps\", \"Meret\", \"Battery\", and choose \"No restrictions\" (or turn off \"Power saving\" for Meret).
Open Settings, then \"Apps\", \"Manage apps\", \"Meret\", and turn on \"Autostart\".
On the same Meret page, open \"Battery saver\" and choose \"No restrictions\".
Open Settings, then \"Battery\" (or \"Apps\", \"Meret\", \"Battery usage\"), and allow Meret to run in the background and to auto-launch.
Open the i Manager app, go to \"App manager\" then \"Autostart manager\", and turn Meret on.
Open Settings, then \"Battery\", \"Background power consumption management\", and set Meret to \"Allow\".
Open Settings, then \"Battery\", \"App launch\". Find Meret, turn off \"Manage automatically\", and turn on \"Auto-launch\", \"Secondary launch\" and \"Run in background\".
Open Settings, then \"Battery\" (or \"Device care\", \"Battery\"), \"Background usage limits\", \"Never sleeping apps\", and add Meret.
Open Settings, then \"Battery\", \"Battery optimisation\", find Meret, and choose \"Don\'t optimise\".
Open Settings, then \"Apps\", \"Meret\", \"Battery\", and choose \"Unrestricted\" or \"Don\'t optimise\".
